room_rent.note: Up to 1% of Sum Insured per day for non-ICU room. If higher room opted, co-payment applies on Associated Medical Expenses (excl. pharmacy, consumables, implants, diagnostics). ICU at actuals with no co-payment.

icu.note: No cap on ICU room rent; no co-payment applies for ICU admission.

copayment.note: 10% mandatory co-payment on each admissible hospitalisation bill (excluding pre/post hospitalisation). Lifelong. Additional room-rent co-payment (15%) may also apply if higher room opted.

sub_limits.note: 12 listed modern treatment procedures (robotic surgery, oral chemo, intravitreal injections, etc.) capped at 50% of SI per policy period. No other disease-wise sub-limits stated.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 16 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement, stones, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative bonus mentioned in the policy wording.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre and post hospitalisation combined capped at 2% of SI per hospitalisation.

post_hosp.note: Pre and post hospitalisation combined capped at 2% of SI per hospitalisation.

day_care.note: Extensive list of 400+ procedures covered; also any other procedure agreed by insurer requiring <24 hrs due to technology advancement.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusions (clause aa).

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation for accident and illness covered. Preventive/rejuvenation treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Donor screening, treatment and surgery expenses explicitly excluded.

ambulance.note: Ambulance listed as a non-payable item in Annexure 1 (List I, item 67). No ambulance benefit mentioned.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatment procedures covered but capped at 50% of SI per policy period. Co-payment waived for these procedures.

consumables.note: Consumables (gloves, etc.) listed as non-payable in Annexure 1.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly instalment; 30 days for all other modes.

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary hospitalisation, OPD, maternity, organ donor, ambulance, consumables, overseas treatment, stem cell storage, infertility/ART
optional_riders: Optional co-payment of 20% or 30% (premium discount); long-term policy discount (2yr: 5%, 3yr: 10%); family discount 5%
